about_the_game:
Face the challenges of the driest regions of the 19th-century Brazilian backlands to complete a migratory journey full of touching stories.

Cícera continues her journey in this single-player game that combines elements of adventure and exploration. Gather resources, build utensils, learn how to use tools, and interact with other travelers and residents of the backlands. Be strong. Have faith and wisdom to identify the clues that may lead you to the historic town of Canudos!

FEATURES

Prepared for the night

Day and night in the backlands add greater needs for provisions and defense. When the sunlight disappears, new threats will emerge. And new guides too!

Accompanied on the journey

A solitary journey in the backlands can be very dangerous. Who knows, you might find someone (or something) that will serve as a companion.

Equipped for adventure

The challenges of the backlands require equipment. Use your machete and hoe for vital tasks such as getting water, and food and opening paths.

Recipes to practice

Living in the backlands requires its own science. The fauna and flora are unique, so try to learn the recipes available for crafting with typical items from the region.

Interact to survive

Hunger and thirst can be very cruel in times of drought. Interact with the residents and travelers of the backlands to gain access to new stories and learnings.

Explore to know

Explore the most arid regions to learn more about the backlands and find the resources you need to stay on your feet. A full inventory is always a good idea!

Stories to learn

The backlands are a special place, with unique stories that could only happen there. Venture out to find lost objects and stories from other travelers.
